title: Notice Days Counted for the Late-Cancellation Fee of an In-Person Appointments Visit
content:
The notice days counted for the late-cancellation fee an In-Person Appointments visit carries are the calendar days from the cancellation date to the scheduled date, the cancellation date not counted, with this adjustment for the visit type's preparation instructions:

1. where the visit type sends preparation instructions **3 or more days** before the visit, the notice days are counted only to the day those instructions go out, that is, reduced by the visit type's preparation days;
2. where it sends them **1 or 2 days** before the visit, they are counted only to the day before the visit, that is, reduced by 1 day;
3. where it sends none, they are the calendar days as counted.

The visit type's preparation days are the days before the visit on which the patient communications schedule sends preparation instructions: 7 for the In-Office Procedure Visit, 3 for the Annual Preventive Exam and the Advanced Imaging Appointment, 2 for the New Patient Office Visit and the Specialist Consultation, none for the Nurse Visit and the Established Patient Office Visit.

**Input, judgement, output (hypothetical cancellations, each 10 calendar days before the scheduled date).**

| Visit type | Preparation days | Band of the rule | Notice days counted |
|---|---|---|---|
| In-Office Procedure Visit | 7 | 3 or more | 3 |
| Annual Preventive Exam | 3 | 3 or more | 7 |
| Specialist Consultation | 2 | 1 or 2 | 9 |
| Established Patient Office Visit | none | none sent | 10 |

**Points of judgement.**

- The dividing line between the first two bands is 3 preparation days: 3 subtracts all 3 days, 2 subtracts only 1.
- The count starts on the day after the cancellation date and runs to the scheduled date; the time of day plays no part.
